notes: Data sourcing limitation: SEC filing HTML endpoints were inaccessible from the environment; historical financial line items and balance-sheet components were taken from StockAnalysis/StockTitan summaries that are derived from Chevron filings. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/cvx/financials/))

EBIT definition: historical EBIT is taken as StockAnalysis “EBIT” (Operating Income) rather than a manually reconstructed EBIT from line items; ensure consistency with the DCF engine’s EBIT-to-tax mapping. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/cvx/financials/))

NWC construction: modeled as (Accounts Receivable + Inventory + Other Current Assets) − (Accounts Payable + Accrued Expenses + Other Current Liabilities), excluding cash/short-term investments and excluding short-term debt (for an operating working-capital proxy). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/cvx/financials/balance-sheet/))

Capex rounding: StockTitan capex values are presented in billions with limited precision; converted to full units (e.g., $17.3B -> 17,300,000,000). ([stocktitan.net](https://www.stocktitan.net/financials/CVX/))

Comps limitation: comps use EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA from StockAnalysis as proxies for EV/NTM Revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA; where strict NTM revenue/EBITDA is unavailable, multiples may not match exact NTM definitions.
NOL balance: set to null because the carryforward balance was not reliably retrievable from the accessible sources in this run; NOL utilization remains provided as 0.80 per the pipeline template.

catalysts: Delivery on cost reduction program (structural savings referenced by management) could support upside EBIT margin versus base case. ([d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net](https://d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net/pdf/15d1b187361bcfb6264f0fbb7f106ce6f7a1aa6238bd042232cd9c012c8dc5d7.pdf))

Production execution toward the upper end of 2026 guidance (+10%) could lift earnings and cash flow generation. ([d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net](https://d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net/pdf/15d1b187361bcfb6264f0fbb7f106ce6f7a1aa6238bd042232cd9c012c8dc5d7.pdf))
Commodity price and refining/marketing margin regime shifts could accelerate cash flow and enhance shareholder return capacity.
company_overview: Integrated energy company with upstream and downstream operations plus chemicals exposure, reporting a scale platform across multiple basins.
Key assets and growth platforms highlighted in recent management materials include Permian/US operations and large-scale gas and deepwater development in international regions.

Management emphasizes capital discipline, structural cost reductions, and sustained shareholder returns (dividends and buybacks). ([d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net](https://d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net/pdf/15d1b187361bcfb6264f0fbb7f106ce6f7a1aa6238bd042232cd9c012c8dc5d7.pdf))
current_context: 4Q25 earnings were $2.8 billion ($1.39 per diluted share); adjusted earnings were $3.0 billion ($1.52 per diluted share). ([d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net](https://d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net/pdf/15d1b187361bcfb6264f0fbb7f106ce6f7a1aa6238bd042232cd9c012c8dc5d7.pdf))

FY2025 cash flow from operations was $33.9 billion (CFFO ex working capital: $34.9 billion), with total capex of $17.3 billion. ([d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net](https://d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net/pdf/15d1b187361bcfb6264f0fbb7f106ce6f7a1aa6238bd042232cd9c012c8dc5d7.pdf))

2026 production outlook is +7% to +10% (excluding asset sales), with management also citing ongoing structural cost savings. ([d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net](https://d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net/pdf/15d1b187361bcfb6264f0fbb7f106ce6f7a1aa6238bd042232cd9c012c8dc5d7.pdf))

FY2025 cash returned included $12.8 billion of dividends and $12.1 billion of share repurchases. ([d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net](https://d5bp8bijhhba2.cloudfront.net/pdf/15d1b187361bcfb6264f0fbb7f106ce6f7a1aa6238bd042232cd9c012c8dc5d7.pdf))
investment_highlights: Base case uses modest revenue growth (2.0%–2.5% annually) consistent with a steady-through-cycle production growth outlook.
EBIT margin in the base case converges toward ~0.11 as structural cost actions and operating discipline flow through earnings.
Capex is held disciplined at ~8.7%–9.0% of sales to balance growth and cash generation.
Working capital intensity is modeled near-flat (NWC close to ~0.15%–0.17% of sales) to avoid overstating cash conversion.
key_risks: Oil, gas, and downstream margin volatility can quickly compress EBIT margins and cash generation versus model expectations.
Project execution risk (timing/downtime), cost overruns, and commodity supply interruptions could delay cash flows and raise capex intensity.
Geopolitical and regulatory risks across major operating regions (including sanctions/carbon policy) may increase costs or constrain operations.

valuation_summary: DCF base case is anchored on historical revenue/EBIT and cash reinvestment behavior, with a normalized margin profile and an exit multiple terminal approach.
Terminal assumptions (2.0% terminal growth; 7.0x EV/EBITDA exit) are designed to be consistent with peer-sector valuation ranges.
Peer comp snapshot uses large integrated/commodity-linked energy peers with forward P/E and EV/EBITDA for cross-checking valuation reasonableness.
